The main takeaway from our work is that

the electronic structure and bonding nature of transition metal nitride alloys can be tailored to improve their toughness, and hence their performance, by controlling the alloy composition and microstructure.
the combination of high hardness and ductility can be achieved through the control of electronic structure, which can be realized by the introduction of N anion vacancies and/or alloying.
the combination of hardness with high ductility is possible in a wide variety of materials.
